description: This file defines null sink classes for various F1-U and RLC bearers used to discard events during UE bearer destruction, and implements disconnect methods that connect these null bearers.

classes.name: null_sink_f1c_bearer
classes.description: A null implementation of f1c_bearer that discards PDU handling and notifications.

classes.name: null_sink_f1u_bearer
classes.description: A null implementation of f1u_bearer and related handler interfaces that discards events.

classes.name: null_sink_rlc_bearer
classes.description: A null implementation of RLC bearer interfaces that discards SDU and PDU handling.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the adapter by connecting it to the corresponding null bearer.
